name: KENT Maxx
summary: Featuring KENT Maxx, a wall mountable UV water purifier with transparent detachable storage tank that purifies water through double purification process of UV+UF.
intro: KENT MAXX is a wall-mounted water purifier designed for tap and municipal water supply. It uses a multi-stage purification process with Sediment Filter, Activated Carbon Filter, UF (Ultrafiltration), and UV (Ultraviolet) disinfection to provide safe and clean drinking water. Its compact design, 7-litre storage tank, and energy-efficient operation make it suitable for homes and small offices.
